context.transcript:
Thanks for listening to Radio 101, Ashton's local news station.
Tonight's featured story is the town's plan to renovate the old railroad line that runs alongside Dorset Avenue.
The line has been out of service for over 40 years and the tracks are now rusted.
The line will be converted into a beautiful walking... path and new community garden.
Several designs have been proposed and digital images are available on the town's website.
Residents are encouraged to view the designs and vote on their favorite.
Just keep in mind that construction will begin in two months.
context.transcript_translation:
感谢收听Radio 101，阿什顿当地新闻台。
今晚的重点报道是该镇计划翻修沿着多塞特大道（Dorset Avenue）运行的旧铁路线。
这条线路已经停运了超过40年，铁轨现在已经生锈了。
这条线路将被改造成一条美丽的步行...小径和新的社区花园。
已经提出了几个设计方案，并在镇的网站上可以查看数字图片。
鼓励居民查看这些设计并投票选出最喜欢的。
请记住，施工将在两个月后开始。
